messages:
jess: FYI — after console 2.1 canary at 10:18 UTC I’m seeing a ~3x jump in auth-decision events in prod telemetry. Anyone seeing the same?

mike: yup saw it. alert fired at 10:24. counts went from ~11k/hr -> ~34k/hr.

infra-bot: [ALERT] metric auth.decision.count exceeded threshold (10k/hr -> 34k/hr) - 2025-11-03T10:24:16Z

ara: did the canary change sampling? I thought we only toggled dashboard queries.

mike: I pushed a debug tweak to the auth service to enable explain traces for a subset to help rollouts. config diff:
```
# auth-config.yml
decision_sampling:
  enabled: true
  rate: 0.01 -> 0.05
policy_explain: false -> true
```

jess: ohhh policy_explain was toggled too? that explains the extra payloads in the pipeline.

sam: that explain traces fan out a lot — each explain triggers policy engine evals + extra logs. should revert to previous sampling immediately.

liz: created dashboard tile 'auth: explain vs decision' and added alert on explain.rate > 0.02. link: https://console.redwood/internals/dash/abc123

mike: rolling back explain flag in the canary now. will also set sampling rate back to 0.01 and restart pods.

jess: thanks. can we add a short-term quota rule to throttle explain traces per org? big customers could get noisy.

ara: yes — propose per-org explain cap + grace for canary orgs. will draft RFC and telemetry schema change to distinguish explain_count vs decision_count.

sam: patch applied to canary at 10:40 UTC, pods restarting. monitoring logs + cost metric.

infra-bot: [RESOLVED] metric auth.decision.count back to baseline - 2025-11-03T10:49:12Z

jess: closing loop — file an ops postmortem? quick notes in #postmortems would be good.

mike: will write short postmortem and add console UX guardrails so toggles also warn about explain=true.

liz: will update runbook to include 'if explain spikes, throttle at gateway'.

jess: cool — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
